rationale: S-0084-05 proposes a channel-knockout DSI causal-attribution variant of t0084's correlation-based fractional-channel-contribution metric (4 conditions: full / NMDA-knockout / Nav1.6-knockout / NaP-knockout x 8 directions per cell on cells 767 / 637 / 762). This scope is a strict subset of S-0088-01's binary knockout per cluster representative (4 cluster reps x 16 directions, broader cell-pool coverage), which is itself covered by t0090 Phase G. S-0084-05's older 3-cell scope is fully subsumed by S-0088-01's t0088-cluster-representative scope. Rejecting as duplicate of a covered suggestion.
